name: Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial Co., Ltd., a Chengdu company founded in 2008 and owned by Sichuan Hengsheng Herui Industrial Group Co., Ltd., supplies tea drinks in China under the ChaPanda name, through its own and franchised outlets. It also manages its supply chain, supports and trains franchisees, makes biodegradable straws and packaging, and provides IT services and logistics.
